NextPlat Reports 3Q Results with Nearly 35% Improvement in Year-Over-Year Gross Profit, Consolidated Quarterly Gross Margins of 35% & Approximately 66% Reduction in Net Loss

 

Company Sees 72% Growth in Higher Margin 340B Prescription Volumes as it Continues to Expand its Pharmacy Footprint

 

HALLANDALE BEACH, FL – November 12, 2026 – NextPlat Corp (NASDAQ: NXPL) (“NextPlat” or the “Company”), a global consumer products and services company providing healthcare and technology solutions through e-commerce and retail channels worldwide, today announced operating results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.

 

“Our third quarter results reflect continued year-over-year improvement across the business, driven by the refocusing of our healthcare operations on high-value, high-margin services designed to deliver consistent bottom-line results in what remains a dynamic market,” said David Phipps, Chief Executive Officer and President of NextPlat Corp. “Our focus remains on growth and profitability through our differentiated, high-value healthcare services and expanding community pharmacy network, including our new Scott’s location near Pensacola and a new pharmacy in Jacksonville, supported by a more efficient operating structure. Looking ahead, we anticipate further progress on our growth initiatives, including selective acquisitions, the introduction of new value-added services such as automated dispensing, and entry into new online healthcare and consumer markets

 

Third Quarter 2026 Financial Highlights:

 

● Consolidated revenue for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, was approximately $10.5 million versus $13.8 million reported in the third quarter of 2025. The change in revenue largely reflects lower reimbursement rates along with lower retail prescription volumes from our Healthcare operations. While these lower reimbursements reduce reported top-line revenue, they have contributed to a meaningful improvement in the Company’s gross margin. The Company expects retail prescription volumes to increase starting in the fourth quarter as it begins to recognize contributions from its recently acquired Pensacola area pharmacy and the opening of its new Jacksonville location.
     
  ○ Third quarter 2026 results reflected continued progress in the Company’s Healthcare operations as it works to expand its higher-value contracted pharmacy services offerings focused on supporting the needs of 340B, medication fulfillment facilities and other healthcare providers. Pharmacy contract revenue increased 300% to approximately $2.4 million compared with approximately $0.6 million in the prior-year period. The increase was attributable to growth in 340B contract revenue of approximately $1.6 million, which was driven by an increase in our existing 340B contracts of approximately $1.0 million and an increase in new 340B contract revenue of approximately $0.6 million, and an increase in medication fulfillment contract services of approximately $0.2 million. Pharmacy prescription revenue was approximately $4.3 million compared with approximately $9.5 million in the prior-year period. As anticipated, the year-over-year change mainly reflected lower reimbursement rates along and lower retail prescription volumes, factors that reduced top-line prescription revenue but helped strengthen segment gross margin. The strong growth in contracted 340B revenue partially offset the expected retail prescription reduction, demonstrating its potential to contribute more meaningfully in the coming quarters.
     
  ○ Third quarter 2026 e-commerce revenue increased 3% to approximately $3.8 million, compared with approximately $3.7 million in the third quarter of 2025, driven by record high-margin, recurring airtime contract revenue. Growth reflected continued strong global demand for satellite connectivity hardware and airtime services, with sales to customers in more than 115 countries during the quarter, and around 150 year-to-date. Sales through leading international e-commerce marketplaces remained strong. During the third quarter, the Company expanded its international sales channels through Decathlon, a leading international sporting-goods retailer, offering satellite connectivity products to online customers in 20 countries. The Company expects to attract additional new customers by launching on more international marketplaces during the fourth quarter and beyond.
     
● Overall gross margin for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, remained near-record levels at approximately 35.0% compared to 19.9% recorded in 2025.
   
  ○ Gross margin in the Company’s Healthcare Operations segment continued to remain strong at approximately 41%, a 23 percentage point improvement from 18% recorded in the third quarter of 2025.
     
  ○ Gross margin in the Company’s e-Commerce Operations remained stable year-over-year during the third quarter of 2026 at approximately 24%.
   
● Total operating expenses for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 decreased to approximately $4.5 million from approximately $4.9 million in the prior year’s quarter primarily due to a decrease in salaries, wages and payroll taxes of approximately $0.3 million, a decrease in the loss on settlement of litigation of approximately $0.3 million, partially offset by the increase in professional fees of approximately $0.1 million.
   
● Net loss attributable to common stockholders for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 decreased approximately 66% to approximately $0.7 million or ($0.28) per diluted share, compared to a net loss attributable to common stockholders of approximately $2.2 million, or ($0.84) per diluted share for the three months ended September 30, 2025.
     
● The Company ended the quarter with approximately $11.2 million in cash, working capital of approximately $13.5 million, and no material unsecured debt as of September 30, 2026.

 

 
 

 

Organizational Highlights and Recent Business Developments:

 

● During the quarter, the Company’s Healthcare Operations saw continued growth in its higher-margin 340B contracted pharmacy services segment as prescription volumes grew nearly 72% year-over-year driven by the addition of multiple new entities secured since late last year. In the third quarter, the Company added three new 340B services contracts. Onboarding of these new customers is currently underway and is expected to contribute to increased revenue in early 2027.
   
● The Company continued to execute on its PharmcoRx pharmacy expansion plans, completing the profitable acquisition of Scott’s pharmacy in the Pensacola area of Northwest Florida immediately after the close of the quarter, and last month, announced the opening of its newest location in Jacksonville. Operating results of Scott’s Pharmacy remain strong as gross margins have improved and do not yet reflect the anticipated contributions from the launch of new high-value healthcare services for regional providers and patients which are currently underway. The Company continues to explore additional selective acquisitions that could significantly increase the scale of its pharmacy network, including those potentially beyond the state of Florida.
   
● E-commerce sales during the third quarter continued to reflect strong demand for satellite-based connectivity, in particular, revenue from airtime services, which reached a record high. The Company opened a new global consumer e-commerce sales channel through its UK subsidiary, Global Telesat Communications Ltd (GTC) in agreement with Decathlon, a leading international sporting-goods retailer which has begun selling an array of satellite connectivity products to its online customers in 20 countries.
   
● The Company is on track to launch its new nationwide medication fulfillment website during the fourth quarter following a comprehensive optimization of the platform to support e-commerce at scale. The new site will provide consumers across all 50 U.S. states with convenient online access to prescription and over-the-counter healthcare products and is expected to significantly expand PharmcoRx’s reach beyond Florida, establish a scalable national e-commerce sales channel, and support future healthcare revenue growth through broader consumer access and new partnership opportunities.

About NextPlat Corp

 

NextPlat is a global consumer products and services company providing healthcare and technology solutions through e-Commerce and retail channels worldwide. Through acquisitions, joint ventures and collaborations, the Company seeks to assist businesses in selling their goods online, domestically, and internationally, allowing customers and partners to optimize their e-Commerce presence and revenue. NextPlat currently operates an e-Commerce communications division offering voice, data, tracking, and IoT products and services worldwide as well as pharmacy and healthcare data management services in the United States through its subsidiary, Progressive Care.
